mapper.select: SELECT tool_name AS toolName, COUNT(*) AS count, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(duration_ms), 0), 0) AS avgDurationMs, IFNULL(MAX(duration_ms), 0) AS maxDurationMs, SUM(CASE WHEN is_truncated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS truncatedCount FROM agent_trace WHERE step_type = 'tool_call' AND tool_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT d.dt AS date, IFNULL(t.conversations, 0) AS conversations, IFNULL(t.toolCalls, 0) AS toolCalls, IFNULL(t.truncated, 0) AS truncated, IFNULL(e.dislikes, 0) AS dislikes FROM ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt FROM agent_trace
created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS conversations, SUM(CASE WHEN step_type = 'tool_call' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS toolCalls, SUM(CASE WHEN is_truncated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS truncated FROM agent_trace
created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ) t ON d.dt = t.dt LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS dislikes FROM eval_candidate WHERE source = 'chat'
AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ) e ON d.dt = e.dt ORDER BY d.dt ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN tool_names LIKE '%readFile%' OR tool_names LIKE '%grepCode%' OR tool_names LIKE '%listFiles%' THEN 'source-code-analysis' WHEN tool_names LIKE '%listTasks%' OR tool_names LIKE '%createTask%' OR tool_names LIKE '%getTask%' THEN 'task-management' WHEN tool_names LIKE '%knowledgeSearch%' THEN 'knowledge-qa' ELSE 'general-chat' END AS skill, COUNT(*) AS conversationCount FROM ( SELECT conversation_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tool_name) AS tool_names FROM agent_trace WHERE tool_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY conversation_id ) skill_map GROUP BY skill ORDER BY conversationCount DESC
